The 12 tribes of Israel were divided into two kingdoms, the Northern Kingdom. The Assyrians came in and attacked them and dragged them away. The Southern Kingdom, which included Zion and Jerusalem, the Babylonians went in and attacked them. And the Babylonians were ruthless. They burned down homes. They destroyed the temple. They grabbed the leaders of Jerusalem and they executed them publicly.
